text:
Run-down districts are being cleared and rebuilt in many cities, and the question is whether the advantages of urban renewal projects outweigh the displacement they cause. This essay will discuss both sides before explaining my own view.

On the positive side, urban renewal improves neighbourhoods. New buildings, services and investment raise safety and property values. A former industrial district that is replaced by modern flats, parks and shops, for example, becomes attractive to businesses and residents, and it provides construction and permanent jobs. Old, unsafe housing without proper sanitation is replaced by healthy homes, and better lighting and design reduce crime. Renewal can also connect neglected areas to the rest of the city through new roads, tram lines and public squares, and it increases the tax revenue that pays for local services.

On the negative side, rising rents and evictions push out low-income residents and destroy community ties. A family that has lived in a district for thirty years, for example, may be unable to afford the new flats and must move to the outskirts, far from friends, schools and work. Small shops and traditional crafts disappear when the buildings are demolished. Some projects benefit developers and wealthy buyers more than the original residents. Nevertheless, the harm can be reduced if governments guarantee fair compensation, provide new homes in the same district, keep a share of the flats at affordable rents and consult local people from the beginning.

In conclusion, urban renewal brings real benefits to neighbourhoods and cities. On balance, I believe that the advantages outweigh the displacement only when residents are protected by compensation and the right to return.

plan.think: Mở bài nêu khu xuống cấp bị giải toả, xây lại; hỏi ưu có vượt di dời.

Cải thiện khu phố: nhà mới, dịch vụ, đầu tư, an toàn, giá trị; ví dụ khu công nghiệp cũ thành nhà hiện đại, công viên, cửa hàng hấp dẫn doanh nghiệp, việc làm; nhà không vệ sinh thay lành mạnh; ánh sáng, thiết kế giảm tội phạm; đường, tàu điện nối; thuế.

Tiền thuê tăng, đuổi, mất cộng đồng; ví dụ gia đình 30 năm không mua nổi căn mới phải ra ngoại ô xa bạn, trường, việc; cửa hàng nhỏ, nghề truyền thống mất; dự án lợi chủ đầu tư hơn dân; giảm hại: bồi thường, nhà mới cùng khu, tỷ lệ giá thuê hợp lý, tham vấn.
Ưu vượt di dời nếu dân được bảo vệ bồi thường, quyền trở lại.
